svg.aria-label: Start B3 + F4, end C4 + E4. The lower voice moves from B3 to C4. The upper voice moves from F4 to E4. The voices move toward each other.
svg.title: Contrary motion, together: the voices move toward each other

g.text: How to read this graphic: The dashed shapes
are where the voices started, on B3 and F4.
The arrows go toward each other and end on C4
and E4. The picture shows the movement only;
nothing is named or counted, and no colour is
